_comment: Scope gate. Roles and per-role denials are read from the board (single source of truth) for the role, and from this file for the policy. Tool names follow deepagents' builtin filesystem middleware: ls/read_file/write_file/edit_file/delete/glob/grep/execute. deny_tools_by_role is applied as-is; read_only_roles only changes the wording of the refusal. The SM must keep `execute`: DoD verification means running commands and calling the board RPC, and blocking it turns every review into tooling_blocked.
